Name: HealAssist
Author: monkdim
Punchline: One-button raise targeting and lowest-HP targeting for healers.
Description:
HealAssist gives you two commands built for hotbar macros or crossbar slots:

• /harez — targets the highest-priority raisable dead party member, using a priority list you build yourself (by role, or by specific player name).
• /halow — targets the party member with the lowest HP percentage.

HealAssist only changes your target. Your macro casts the spell, so the game's own cast/queue rules apply exactly as if you had clicked the party member yourself. An opt-in setting can have the plugin fire the raise for you instead.
